entries.zh: 行文、作文（原注西语：无用、不切题）
entries.en: useless, unprofitable; impertinent, out of place (Chinese gloss: to write, composition)
entries.notes: 四栏齐备，但西语词头 desaprovechado, impertinente 与汉字「行文」的对应依赖推断，疑指无益、不切题之文

entries.en: [damaged original, gloss uncertain] — Spanish line reads: useless, like those of the sea
entries.notes: 西语 cono[残]ma（疑为 como）句尾残缺，汉字「提嘴」与「无用」对应不明

entries.zh: 多言聒噪、无用之人（汉字栏作「聽穿」，义未详）
entries.en: a useless babbler, chatterer; talkative person (Spanish clause 'of wild beasts...' runs on to the next page)
entries.notes: 西语词尾 redan- 断于换页未完；「聽穿」与词头的对应存疑

entries.zh: 开闸：启放水闸、闸门（海务词条）
开、打开（海务词条，西注 abrir）
解开、松解（解绳结、解卷／剥解）
entries.en: to untie, undo; to loosen, unroll
to undress, take off (clothes); to untie

entries.zh: 解开束缚、解缚；剥、剥脱（汉字栏作「解剥」）
entries.en: to untie, unbind; to peel off, strip
to untie and let loose, release; set down

entries.zh: 解开结头（头上发结、绳结）
entries.en: to untie knots (on the head); to undo
entries.notes: 西语 desnud. 为缩写（desnudar），展开依赖推断；与「解結頭」对应略松

entries.zh: 颠倒；言语颠倒、荒谬失当
entries.en: inverted, topsy-turvy; absurd, senseless in speech
entries.notes: 缩写 g. voc. 展开依赖推断（疑为 voce/vocablo 类标注）；desatinado 取「言语荒谬」义对应「颠倒」

entries.zh: 败兵：击溃军队；破毁、败坏
entries.en: to rout, defeat (troops); to ruin, break up, squander (Spanish gloss: deshacer, quebrar &c.)
[damaged original, gloss uncertain] — Spanish line suggests: to fall down a ravine/cliff, take a plunge
entries.notes: 西语条尾 [残]；汉字「陌」与 M 栏音写「Cam.」同词头语义无法对应
